# 0006. Messy-data fixtures are small synthetic files, generated by a script and committed

Date: 2026-10-16   Status: accepted (plan default D7)   Tier: T2

## Context
Every messy-data case in docs/spec.md needs a fixture CI can run. Real footage brings license and privacy risk, and large files need Git LFS.

## Options
1. Generate with FFmpeg test sources from `scripts/make_fixtures.py`, commit the outputs (under 5 MB total). Pros: license-free, reproducible, no LFS, CI does not need FFmpeg's encoders. Cons: synthetic content does not exercise model quality.
2. Generate in CI on every run. Cons: CI depends on a specific FFmpeg build; outputs vary across FFmpeg versions.
3. Real clips via Git LFS. Cons: licenses, privacy, LFS bandwidth.

## Decision
Option 1. Speech fixtures use espeak-ng (see ADR 0007), since FFmpeg's test sources cannot produce speech. `tests/fixtures/manifest.json` records each file's sha256 so a regenerated set shows up as a diff.

## Consequences
Model-quality evals use separate, licensed datasets in the cloud (docs/spec.md, Evals), never these fixtures.

## Revisit if
The fixtures pass 5 MB, or a messy case cannot be produced synthetically.
